Jared (Billing): Heads-up: We found a discrepancy in the sample billing export for the bucket experiment. Some charges show negative rounding adjustments.
Maya (Finance): How many affected?
Lucas (Data): 12k rows in sample. 34 negative adjustments > $0.01. Appears to be when usage < 1000 but internal rounding applied incorrectly.
Jared (Billing): Could be due to prorate logic combined with credits. Needs quick patch.
Sophie (Legal): Any customer-facing impact? We should escrow those invoices until fixed.
BillingBot: Flagged invoices: inv-778, inv-781, inv-786. Marked for hold.
Maya (Finance): Put them on hold and notify customer success.
Jared (Billing): Patch rolling in now to fix rounding flow. I'll re-run parser after patch.
Lucas (Data): After patch re-run, will validate distribution and share updated CSV.
Sophie (Legal): Keep a changelog of the fix for audit.
Jared (Billing): Will attach commit hash and diff link when done.
BillingBot: Parser re-run complete: 50/50 success. Replaced held invoices with corrected previews.
Maya (Finance): Confirming hold released, notify CS to proceed.
Jared (Billing): Thanks team. We'll include a short note in the invoice PDF footer: "Billing adjustments applied during experimental rollout."
